subject: Biology
title: Photosynthesis in Higher Plants
summary: Photosynthesis autotroph nutrition ka base hai: light energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6H₂O + 6O₂. Ye chloroplast mein hota hai — light reactions grana (thylakoids) mein, dark (biosynthetic) reactions stroma mein.
Light reactions paani todti hain, O₂ chhodti hain aur Z-scheme (non-cyclic photophosphorylation) se ATP aur NADPH banati hain. ATP chemiosmosis se banta hai.

Calvin cycle (C₃ pathway) RuBisCO se CO₂ ko RuBP par fix karta hai; C₄ plants (maize, sugarcane) pehle mesophyll cells mein PEP carboxylase se CO₂ fix karte hain aur Kranz anatomy rakhte hain, jisse photorespiration nahi hota.
Photosynthesis ki rate light, CO₂, temperature aur paani par depend karti hai — Blackman ka law of limiting factor.

formulas.name: Overall equation
formulas.mistake: Nikli O₂ paani se aati hai, CO₂ se nahi (Cornelius van Niel; ¹⁸O se confirm) — galat mat likhna.

formulas.name: Early experiments
formulas.formula: Priestley (1770): plants restore air (mouse and candle);  Ingenhousz: needs sunlight, only green parts;  Sachs (1854): glucose made, stored as starch;  Engelmann: action spectrum with Cladophora and aerobic bacteria (blue and red light)

formulas.name: Pigments
formulas.formula: chlorophyll a (bright/blue-green, main pigment, reaction centre);  chlorophyll b (yellow-green);  xanthophylls (yellow);  carotenoids (yellow-orange) — accessory pigments that also protect chlorophyll from photo-oxidation

formulas.name: Photosystems
formulas.formula: PS I reaction centre P700;  PS II reaction centre P680;  LHC (antenna) of hundreds of pigment molecules

formulas.name: Photolysis of water
formulas.formula: 2H₂O → 4H⁺ + O₂ + 4e⁻ (on the inner side of thylakoid membrane, linked to PS II; Mn, Cl⁻ needed)

formulas.name: Non-cyclic vs cyclic photophosphorylation
formulas.formula: non-cyclic: PS II + PS I, gives ATP + NADPH + O₂ (Z-scheme);  cyclic: only PS I, gives only ATP, in stroma lamellae (no NADP reductase there)

formulas.name: Chemiosmosis
formulas.formula: proton gradient across thylakoid membrane (high H⁺ in lumen) → H⁺ flow through CF₀ to CF₁ of ATP synthase → ATP

formulas.name: Calvin cycle
formulas.formula: carboxylation: RuBP + CO₂ → 2 × 3-PGA (RuBisCO);  reduction: uses ATP + NADPH;  regeneration of RuBP

formulas.name: C₄ (Hatch–Slack) pathway
formulas.formula: PEP (3C) + CO₂ → OAA (4C) by PEP carboxylase in mesophyll → malate/aspartate → bundle sheath → releases CO₂ for Calvin cycle → pyruvate back to mesophyll
formulas.when: C₄ plants: maize, sugarcane, sorghum, Amaranthus.

formulas.name: Kranz anatomy
formulas.formula: large bundle sheath cells around vascular bundles, many chloroplasts, thick walls impervious to gas, no intercellular spaces

formulas.name: Photorespiration
formulas.formula: RuBisCO binds O₂: RuBP + O₂ → phosphoglycerate + phosphoglycolate; no sugar, no ATP — wasteful; in chloroplast, peroxisome and mitochondria
formulas.mistake: C₄ plants mein photorespiration nahi hota kyunki RuBisCO ke aas-paas CO₂ concentration zyada hota hai.

formulas.name: Blackman's law of limiting factors (1905)
formulas.formula: if a process depends on several factors, its rate is set by the factor nearest its minimal value
formulas.when: Photosynthesis ko affect karne wale factors.

examples.title: ATP aur NADPH ki ginti
examples.problem: Calvin cycle mein ek glucose banane ke liye kitne ATP aur NADPH chahiye?
examples.solution: Har turn mein ek CO₂ ke liye 3 ATP + 2 NADPH, aur glucose ke liye 6 turns: 18 ATP aur 12 NADPH.

examples.title: C₄ plants mein ATP
examples.problem: C₄ plants ko har CO₂ par 2 extra ATP chahiye (PEP regenerate karne ke liye). Ek glucose ke liye ATP?

examples.title: O₂ ka source
examples.problem: Kaise dikhaya gaya ki nikli O₂ paani se aati hai?
examples.solution: Van Niel ke purple aur green sulphur bacteria par kaam se pata chala ki H₂O hydrogen donor hai (H₂S ki tarah); baad mein ¹⁸O-labelled paani ke experiments ne dikhaya ki O₂ paani se aayi.

examples.title: Pehla stable product
examples.problem: C₃ aur C₄ plants mein pehla stable product kya hai?

examples.title: Greenhouse mein limiting factor
examples.problem: Tomatoes aur bell peppers CO₂ bhare greenhouses mein kyun ugaate hain?
examples.solution: CO₂ aksar main limiting factor hota hai; ise badhaane (lagbhag 0.05% tak) se C₃ plants mein photosynthesis ki rate aur yield badhti hai.

examples.title: Cyclic photophosphorylation kahan
examples.problem: Cyclic photophosphorylation kahan hota hai, aur kyun?
examples.solution: Stroma lamellae mein, jinmein PS I hai par PS II aur NADP reductase nahi — isliye electrons ghoom kar waapas aate hain aur sirf ATP banta hai.

topics.title: Site of photosynthesis
topics.explain: Mesophyll cells mein chloroplasts walls ke saath line mein lagte hain taaki sahi light mile. Membranes (grana) light pakad kar ATP aur NADPH banati hain; stroma ke enzymes CO₂ ko sugars mein reduce karte hain (light-independent ya dark reactions).

topics.title: Action and absorption spectra
topics.explain: Chlorophyll a sabse zyada blue aur red regions mein absorb karta hai; photosynthesis ka action spectrum chlorophyll a ke absorption spectrum se kaafi milta hai, par doosre pigments bhi yogdaan dete hain.

topics.title: Electron transport
topics.explain: PS II 680 nm light absorb karta hai; excited electrons plastoquinone, cytochromes b6f aur plastocyanin se PS I tak jaate hain; PS I unhe 700 nm par phir excite karke ferredoxin aur NADP⁺ reductase ko deta hai, NADPH banta hai. PS II ke khoye electrons water splitting se poore hote hain.

topics.title: Proton gradient
topics.explain: Gradient isliye banta hai kyunki water splitting ke protons lumen mein jama hote hain, cytochrome complex se electrons guzarte waqt protons lumen mein jaate hain, aur NADPH banate waqt NADP reductase stroma se protons hataata hai.

topics.title: Factors affecting photosynthesis
topics.explain: Light: kam light par intensity ke saath rate badhti hai, full sunlight ke lagbhag 10% par saturate. CO₂: C₃ plants zyada CO₂ par C₄ se zyada respond karte hain (C₄ ~360 ppm par saturate). Temperature: C₄ plants ka optimum zyada. Water stress stomata band karta aur leaf surface ghataata hai.

topics.title: C₃ vs C₄ comparison
topics.explain: C₄ plants zyada temperature sehte hain, productivity zyada, CO₂ compensation point kam aur photorespiration nahi. C₄ plants mein RuBisCO sirf bundle sheath cells mein; PEP carboxylase sirf mesophyll mein.

ratta: PS I = P700;  PS II = P680.
Non-cyclic: ATP + NADPH + O₂;  cyclic: only ATP (stroma lamellae).
C₃ first product 3-PGA;  C₄ first product OAA.
Photorespiration: RuBisCO + O₂, wasteful, absent in C₄.
